notes.title: Being a DIK - Season 1 is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello!

I'm happy to announce that, after almost 1.5 years of development, the first season of Being a DIK is now live on Steam!
To celebrate, you can now get Acting Lessons and Being a DIK - Season 1 in a discounted bundle.

I have big plans for Being a DIK in the future and what you can play today is a lengthy start of a long adventure.
It couldn't have been achieved without the support I've received from patrons and fans.
The support I've received during development of this game made it possible for me to start working as a full-time indie developer and that has been a dream come true.

Trading cards and community items will be activated as soon as possible; the artwork is ready to go, all that's missing is a player base on Steam.
I hope that this game will bring you lots of joy!

Please, enjoy this labor of love!

Cheers
Dr PinkCake

notes.title: Trading cards are now available!
notes.notes:
Steam trading cards, badges, profile backgrounds and emoticons for Acting Lessons are now available!

In one week, I will be a full-time adult game developer.
I'm currently developing my second game, named Being a DIK, but I'm also releasing small series of lewd images for Acting Lessons.
In the future, the plan is to make these small render sets DLC content, here on Steam.

The render sets will expand a bit on the story of Acting Lessons, by giving glimpses of what happened afterwards in some of the different endings.
[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/KyCc5E4]Join my Discord server[/url] for more information on this.

I have also created a group for my games and community here on Steam.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/DrPinkCake]Join it here[/url].
